excerpt: Slintel was a technographic and buyer-intelligence data company. 6sense acquired it in October 2021, and its data now ships inside 6sense's sales intelligence product.
content:
Slintel sold B2B buyer intelligence: technographic data on which software tools companies use, signals about which companies were in the market to buy, and business contact data. Sales and marketing teams used it to build target account lists, prioritise prospects and personalise outreach. At the time of its sale, 6sense said Slintel captured more than 60 attributes across 15 million companies every week and that its revenue had grown 500% year on year.

Slintel raised money from Indian and global investors. Venture Intelligence, which tracks Indian deals, reported that between December 2019 and June 2021 it raised more than INR 185 crore from GGV Capital, Stellaris Venture Partners, Accel India and Sequoia Capital India. On 5 October 2021 6sense, the US account engagement platform, announced it had acquired Slintel, shortly after buying Fortella; the price was not disclosed, Demand Gen Report noted. 6sense said Slintel's data would feed audience building, AI predictions and account prioritisation in its platform.

Slintel no longer exists as a separate product. Its old website now redirects to 6sense's sales intelligence page, and its data is sold as part of 6sense, which does not publish prices. So anyone looking for Slintel today is really evaluating 6sense against other sales intelligence vendors such as ZoomInfo, Apollo.io and HG Insights. This page records what Slintel was and where it went, using 6sense's own announcement and trade press coverage of the deal.

We have not used Slintel for this page. It brings together Slintel's own website and the reporting linked under Sources, and says where each fact comes from. Nothing here is paid placement.
